name: @polymorph/webcrypto-jco
description: Browser-compatible host for polymorph:webcrypto over the Web Crypto API. No dependencies; map the polymorph:webcrypto imports to webcrypto.js when transpiling with jco.

scripts.types: node ../../scripts/jco-transpile.mjs types wit --world-name imports --async-mode jspi -o generated --feature sha1-checked --feature rsa-sign --feature rsa-oaep-decrypt
